'''Wang Tianpu''' ({{lang-zh|c=王天普|p=Wáng Tiānpǔ}}; born 1962) is a Chinese [[chemical engineer]] and [[CEO]]. He was the former president of [[Sinopec]], one of the three largest [[Government-owned corporation|state-owned]] [[National oil company|oil companies]] in China.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.marketwire.com/press-release/Industrial-Info-Resources-963364.html |title=Sinopec Has World's Third-Largest Oil-Refining Capacity |access-date=2009-03-28 |archive-date=2009-03-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090319131307/http://www.marketwire.com/press-release/Industrial-Info-Resources-963364.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> On April 27, 2015, Wang was placed under investigation by the [[Central Commission for Discipline Inspection]], the [[Chinese Communist Party]]'s internal control body.<ref name="CCDI">{{cite web|url=http://www.ccdi.gov.cn/xwtt/201504/t20150427_55436.html|title=中国石油化工集团公司总经理王天普涉嫌严重违纪违法接受组织调查|access-date=2015-04-27|publisher=Central Commission for Discipline Inspection}}</ref> He expelled from the CCP on September 18, 2015. Two years later, he was sentenced to 15 years and 6 months in prison for graft.<ref name=":0" />

==Biography==
Wang was born in 1962 in [[Changle County]], [[Shandong|Shandong Province]]. In July 1985, Wang obtained [[Bachelor of Engineering|BEng]] in [[Organic chemistry|organic]] [[chemical engineering]] from [[Qingdao University of Science and Technology|Qingdao Institute of Chemical Industry]]. Wang obtained [[MBA]] from [[Dalian University of Technology]] in July 1996. In August 2003, Wang obtained doctor of chemical engineering from [[Zhejiang University]] in [[Hangzhou]]. Wang is a ''(national) senior engineer equivalent to professor'' ({{lang-zh|links=no|c=教授级高级工程师}}).<ref>[http://www.cec-ceda.org.cn/huodong/mxqyj/wangtianpu/ Biography of Wang Tianpu]</ref>

From August 2001 to April 2003, Wang was a vice-president of [[Sinopec]]. From April 2003 to March 2005, Wang was a senior/exclusive vice-president of Sinopec. Since March 2005, Wang has been the [[President (corporate title)|President]] of Sinopec.<ref>[http://finance.sina.com.cn/chanjing/b/20050402/12261482860.shtml 低调王天普登场中石化 (Wang Tianpu is in charge of Sinopec)]</ref> Since May 2006, Wang has been elected as a [[Board of directors|Director of the Board]] of Sinopec.{{citation needed|date=July 2024}}

On April 27, 2015, Wang Tianpu was placed under investigation by the [[Central Commission for Discipline Inspection]] for "serious violations of laws and regulations".<ref name="CCDI"/> Wang was expelled from the CCP on September 18, 2015.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ccdi.gov.cn/xwtt/201509/t20150918_62038.html |title=中国石油化工集团公司原董事、总经理、党组成员王天普严重违纪被开除党籍 |access-date=2015-09-18 |publisher=Central Commission for Discipline Inspection}}</ref> On January 24, 2017, Wang was sentenced to 15 years and 6 months in prison.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|url=http://news.sina.com.cn/c/nd/2017-01-24/doc-ifxzusws0104820.shtml | title=中石化原总经理王天普一审被判15年6个月 |publisher=Sina |date=2017-01-24}}</ref>
